description: This file provides a utility function 'inferColumns' for processing data rows to generate column definitions suitable for a DataTable component. It infers columns based on the present data and an allowlist, with special handling for date fields.

methods.name: inferColumns(rows = [], allowlist = [], options = {})
methods.description: Generates an array of column definitions for DataTable based on provided data rows and allowlist, with options for handling date fields.
